bibliographic.title: Bugseeker
bibliographic.author: Polaris Storm
bibliographic.description:
Bugseeker is a short interactive fiction game about finding bugs and nothing else in particular. Especially not about loneliness and isolation.

Inspired by an actual moment I had at like 5-6 in the morning and then woke up to having the beginnings of this game on my phone, this is my first entry for the Neo-Twiny Jam! It's a pretty simple one, but it's my first detailed attempt at variables with Twine (so if anything's broken, please let me know!). Check this script for how I counted my words!
